name: mcp-server
description: Audit, migrate, verify and keep upgrading existing MCP servers (TypeScript and Python; Streamable HTTP first, stdio second) against a pinned MCP specification revision, 2026-07-28 by default, dual-version with 2025-era clients. Deterministic stdlib validators plus options-first skills: inventory and protocol-era detection, a static MCP0xx review, an OAuth 2.1 AUT0xx review, planned codemods for SDK v1 to v2 that never edit before you confirm, a urllib-only live probe with latency budgets, an Alexa+ add-on readiness overlay, CI gates, and an upgrade loop that turns a new spec revision into a delta, a re-review and a migration.
